I can’t access the repo via tools (every tool call returns “unknown tool”), so I can’t inspect, edit, or run the tests directly. From your note, the focused test output suggests installing the Handlebars debug helper. Smallest likely repair if this is a Node/Handlebars project: 1) Add the dependency: npm install --save-dev helper-debug (or: yarn add -D helper-debug). 2) Register the helper during Handlebars setup, for example: const Handlebars = require('handlebars'); require('helper-debug')({ handlebars: Handlebars }); If you use express-handlebars, either register on the underlying instance: const hbs = exphbs.create(...); require('helper-debug')({ handlebars: hbs.handlebars }); or pass helpers: const hbs = exphbs.create({ helpers: require('helper-debug')() }); 3) Re-run the focused test (e.g., npm test or npm run test:focused) to verify. If this is a Python project, try: pip install helper-debug, then import and wire it where templates are rendered. Once tool access is restored, I will list files, run the focused test, make the minimal formatting fix, and re-run tests to confirm.
